name: Harsewinkel (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, black and yellow with a broad black middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Harsewinkel (a red chevron between a horse's head, a rake and a lion on yellow).
history: Red and gold are the colours of the arms of the old Prince-Bishopric of Münster; flag and banner were granted by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold.

features.role: Harsewinkel arms — chevron, horse's head, rake and lion
